comment: Operator registry for the CLI transport. Stored at the repo root outside the statically served world/ tree. Each entry is an argv array, never a shell string. Extra model-supplied args are refused unless allow_args is true. read_only entries may run through read_cli; everything else needs run_cli and commit approval. env is non-secret literal config; env_from copies a parent environment variable.
